mapper.sql: statistic_product_quantity AS ( SELECT product_id as productId, SUM(quantity) as quantity FROM product_batch GROUP BY product_id )
statistic_product_rating AS ( SELECT product_id as productId, AVG(rating) as rating FROM rating r GROUP BY product_id )

statistic_product_priceAfterDiscount AS ( SELECT p.id as productId, pr.discount_price as discountPrice FROM product p LEFT JOIN promotion pr ON pr.product_id = p.id WHERE pr.start_time <= date(NOW()) AND pr.end_time >= date(NOW()) AND pr.is_active = true )
mapper.select:
WITH , , ,
SELECT p.id as id, p.name as name, p.description as description, p.product_image as productImage, p.sold as sold, p.is_deleted as isDeleted, p.price as price, p.view as view, COALESCE(spq.quantity, 0) as quantity, COALESCE(spr.rating, 0) as totalRating, COALESCE(sur.rating, 0) as userRating, p.price - COALESCE(spp.discountPrice, 0) as priceAfterDiscount, b.id as b_id, b.name as b_name, b.description as b_description, c.id as c_id, c.name as c_name, c.description as c_description FROM product p LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id = p.brand_id LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON pc.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = pc.category_id LEFT JOIN statistic_product_priceAfterDiscount spp ON spp.productId = p.id LEFT JOIN statistic_product_quantity spq ON spq.productId = p.id LEFT JOIN statistic_product_rating spr ON spr.productId = p.id LEFT JOIN statistic_user_rating sur ON sur.productId = p.id WHERE p.id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product(name, description, price, product_image, brand_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{productInfo.name}, #{productInfo.description}, #{productInfo.price}, #{productInfo.productImage}, #{productInfo.brandId}, #{productInfo.isDeleted})
mapper.select:
WITH ,
SELECT p.id as id, p.name as name, p.description as description, p.product_image as productImage, p.sold as sold, p.is_deleted as isDeleted, p.price as price, p.view as view, p.price - COALESCE(spp.discountPrice, 0) as priceAfterDiscount FROM product p INNER JOIN productFilter pf ON p.id = pf.id LEFT JOIN statistic_product_priceAfterDiscount spp ON spp.productId = p.id WHERE p.is_deleted = false
AND p.name like CONCAT("%", #{productName}, "%")
AND p.brand_id = #{brandId}

WITH ,
SELECT p.id as id, p.name as name, p.description as description, p.product_image as productImage, p.sold as sold, p.is_deleted as isDeleted, p.price as price, p.view as view, p.price - COALESCE(spp.discountPrice, 0) as priceAfterDiscount FROM product p INNER JOIN productFilter pf ON p.id = pf.id LEFT JOIN statistic_product_priceAfterDiscount spp ON spp.productId = p.id WHERE p.is_deleted = false
AND p.name like CONCAT("%", #{productName}, "%")
AND p.brand_id = #{brandId}
ORDER BY p.sold DESC
